name: Denki Components
description: Denki Components — a business theme for a passive-components maker, built as a ledger of numbers. A cool pale ground with blue-grey hairlines, indexed product rows with 3:2 photographs at 54 percent and a text column from 63 percent, outline pills with a filled round arrow disc, and a fixed navy badge with a rotating ring of tracked text. The home page opens on a headline over a band of four figures and a framed reel-line photograph with scroll parallax; it continues with a right-hand company introduction, four ruled product families, a monthly ledger beside a sticky photograph, a staggered plant photo field with hash tags, three case rows beside an offset portrait, a sample-kit price list and a request-and-visit block. IBM Plex Serif for headings, IBM Plex Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
